_README: Ye file config hai. 'contact' section se aapka contact block apne aap banega.
_auto_projects_note: false = 'My Projects' table README me khud likha hua hai (11 projects, har ek ka real language percentage). Isko true karein to automation us table ko apne hisaab se bana dega aur ye numbers hat jayenge.
_skills_note: Ye skills badges PEHLE dikhti hain. Naya kuch seekhein to yahan add kar dein. Sirf wahi likhein jo aap SACHCHI jaante hain - recruiter pehla yahi check karta hai.
_skill_groups_note: Badges group me dikhti hain. Naya group ya skill yahan add karo - AUTO:SKILLS block apne aap update ho jayega.
_learning_note: Jo abhi seekh rahe ho. Ye profile par alag dikhega, isse recruiter ko lagta hai ki aap actively seekh rahe ho.

profile.name: Abhijeet Kumar Prajapati
profile.bio: BTech IT (2026) · Building 11 offline-first apps in Python, JavaScript & Java. Zero dependencies, zero cloud — just working software.

contact._show_email_note: true = email dikhega. Chhupani ho to false kar dein.
contact._phone_note: Default: false (chhupa hua). Public phone number se scam/telemarketing calls aati hain - isliye profile par nahi dikhaya. Phone sirf resume/CV me dijiye, jo aap company ko directly bhejte hain.
contact._linkedin_note: Asli LinkedIn URL daalne ke baad ise true kar dein. Abhi placeholder hai isliye band hai - warna toot-ti link public ho jayegi.
contact._messages_note: true = 'message' button bana dega jo mailto: se aapke inbox me message bhejta hai. Isme koi form/server nahi hai, isliye ye safe hai.
contact._response_note: Khali chhodo ya apni SACHCHI time likhein. Jhootha time likha to recruiter expect karega aur aapki impression kharab hogi.
